features: TOUCHES THE DATABASE: ONE NEW COLUMN IN THE «GIÀ VERSATO», NO DATA REWRITTEN — A new migration, which the update runs by itself, adds to the table of the «Già versato» (amount already paid) (contributi_versati) a column with the financial year the amount already paid applies to, and the link to the financial years. It rewrites no data: the amount already paid recorded before applies to all financial years, as before, and right after the update no figure changes. The column and the link each have their own check: a run interrupted halfway resumes from where it had got to, and where it has already run it does nothing. No new permission. Two PHP libraries go up to the version with the fixes (laravel/framework 13.40.0 and inertiajs/inertia-laravel 3.6.0) and the requirements do not change. Four things to know after the update. (a) If you have an amount already paid on a management used in more than one financial year (that is how the importer creates it, and how the ordinary management used every year stays) and the instalment plan for the following year, on that item, stops with the message «Se il già versato è di un esercizio solo, indicalo nella pagina «Già versato» della voce» (if the amount already paid is for one financial year only, say so in the «Già versato» page of the item), open Struttura (Structure), «Già versato», choose the item and, in the box «Per quale esercizio vale?» (which financial year does it apply to?), choose in «Vale per» (applies to) the financial year of the payment; leave «Tutti gli esercizi» (all financial years) for a payment that covers an expense asked over several years, such as a works fund. Then create or generate the plan again. (b) If an earlier version of the panel update added to the .env file, under the TRUSTED_PROXIES block, the three lines DB_CHARSET=utf8, DB_COLLATION=utf8_unicode_ci and DB_ENGINE="InnoDB ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC", after the update the application, where the update from the panel is enabled, removes them and leaves a comment note in their place. It removes them when they are exactly these three lines, whole and one after the other, under the TRUSTED_PROXIES line of a block written by the update; with different lines, detached from the block, or with Windows line endings the file stays as it is. The tables created while those lines were active stay in utf8: the update does not convert them, and in those tables a text with an emoji is not saved and saving gives an error. (c) The panel update engine no longer stops if the page is closed during the update. This applies to updates that start from this version: the update to this version is still run by the engine of the installed version, so stay on the page until the end and, if the update is interrupted, update with the installation file. (d) If you installed KondoManager on a Synology NAS with the previous guide, which had the program built from the source with the development stack (debug on, an administrator with the password written in the guide, the database port and the background-process interface port open on the NAS network with the test credentials, and TRUSTED_PROXIES=* recommended for the proxy), read the section «Se hai già installato con la versione precedente di questa guida» (if you have already installed with the previous version of this guide) of the new guide. Until you move to the new guide, the three steps to take right away are: change from the program the password of the administrator that the old guide had you create; remove from the docker-compose.yml of that folder the ports: block of the db and worker services and recreate the project; write APP_DEBUG=false in the .env and recreate the project. The three steps have not been tried on a NAS. If your .env has TRUSTED_PROXIES=*, the new guide says never to use it. After the update reload the pages that are already open.

CHANGES: THE AMOUNT ALREADY PAID APPLIES TO A FINANCIAL YEAR, AND YOU CHOOSE IT — In the «Già versato» (amount already paid) page of an item (Struttura, «Già versato») there is a new box, «Per quale esercizio vale?» (which financial year does it apply to?), with the menu «Vale per» (applies to): the financial years the item's management is linked to, and «Tutti gli esercizi» (all financial years). The instalment plan of a financial year takes off the amount already paid for that financial year and the one that applies to «Tutti gli esercizi», not the one of another financial year; with «Tutti gli esercizi» all the plans of the item take it off, each for its part, which is the case of a works fund asked over several years. Before, the amount already paid was divided among all the plans of the item, of any financial year, and the plan for the following year on the same item stopped when, together with the earlier year's plan, the sum asked exceeded the item's amount. With Ugo and Bice at 500 thousandths each, «Spese generali» (general expenses) at € 1,200.00, «Pulizie» (cleaning) at € 200.00 and € 300.00 already paid by Ugo for 2026, the 2026 plan asks Ugo € 400.00 and Bice € 700.00, and the 2027 plan asks € 700.00 from both. For an item that has no amount already paid yet the page proposes no financial year and does not save until you choose one, even on a management with a single financial year, because only you know whether the payment is for one year's expense or for more. The list says, for each item that has an amount already paid, «Vale per: Esercizio 2026» (applies to: financial year 2026), «Vale per: Tutti gli esercizi» or «Vale per: Più esercizi» (several financial years: lines of different financial years written outside the page; the page flags them and when you save they all apply to the financial year you choose here), and the box «Effetto sul prossimo piano rate» (effect on the next instalment plan) names the plans it refers to («Effetto sui piani rate di «Esercizio 2026»», effect on the instalment plans of «Esercizio 2026»). If a plan had already taken off an amount already paid and you then indicate another financial year, the plan stays as it is until you recalculate it, where possible: its «Disallineato» (out of line) badge lights up, and the settlement of a handover on the unit keeps using the amount already paid recorded in the plan, without saying the difference. A plan that already has its financial year keeps it even if you recalculate it, or remove an item from it, from the page of another financial year: before, it moved to the financial year of that page.

CHANGES: THE INSTALMENT PLAN CREATED WITHOUT CHOOSING THE ITEMS TAKES THE FREE ITEMS OF ITS FINANCIAL YEAR — A plan created leaving the items field empty takes the management's items that are not already in another instalment plan of the same financial year, as the creation page now says. Before, it took only the items that were in no plan of the management, of any financial year: on a management used in more than one financial year, with «Spese generali» at € 1,200.00 and «Pulizie» at € 200.00 in the earlier year's plan and a new item «Varie» (miscellaneous) of € 300.00, the 2027 plan of Ugo and Bice (500 thousandths each) asked € 150.00 each, «Varie» alone; now it asks € 850.00 each. If all the items are already in plans of the same financial year the plan is not generated; with items without sub-items the message says so: «Impossibile generare il piano rate: tutte le voci di questa gestione sono già nel piano «…», attivo nello stesso esercizio, e un piano creato senza scegliere le voci prende solo quelle che nessun altro piano attivo dello stesso esercizio ha già: non resta nessuna voce da chiedere.» (impossible to generate the instalment plan: all the items of this management are already in the plan «…», active in the same financial year, and a plan created without choosing the items takes only those that no other active plan of the same financial year already has: no item is left to ask). The creation page of the 2027 plan now also proposes the items of the 2026 plan with their full amount (before it gave them as «Interamente finanziato/Esaurito», fully funded/exhausted). The next year's plans already created with the new items only stay as they are: to redo them you delete them (an approved plan is first taken back to draft) and recreate them, if they have no collections or issues and have not been settled by a handover.

CHANGES: THE REFUSALS AND ESTIMATES OF THE AMOUNT ALREADY PAID ACROSS FINANCIAL YEARS SAY THE FACT AND THE WAY — (1) When the amount already paid applies to «Tutti gli esercizi» and the plan is not generated because, with the plans of another financial year or the invoices of other financial years, the sum exceeds the item, the message says so and sends you to the «Già versato» page of the item to indicate the financial year; when the amount already paid is for one financial year only, the plans of that financial year are added up and only its invoices count. (2) The message for the item asked several times by the plans that have an amount already paid no longer proposes to «disattivare uno dei piani rate» (deactivate one of the instalment plans), which no page allows: it says to update the item's amount, to ask for the item with a lower amount, or to remove it from the page of a plan that has other items too. (3) Registering an invoice with an overrun and the «Rata Integrativa» (supplementary instalment) strategy, the item's amount goes up to the real expense only if an amount already paid applies in the invoice's financial year, and with an amount already paid of one financial year only it adds up the invoices of that financial year; before, it added up the invoices of all financial years, and the plan of another year took off the amount already paid only in part. Items already raised that way stay raised: if needed, bring the item's amount back from its page and recalculate. (4) In the invoice's overrun window the estimate of the net remainder takes off the amount already paid of the invoice's financial year and the one for «Tutti gli esercizi»: with a 2027 invoice it no longer takes off the € 300.00 paid for 2026.

CHANGES: PLANS BORN BEFORE THIS VERSION ON A MANAGEMENT USED IN MORE THAN ONE FINANCIAL YEAR ARE NOT RECALCULATED — An instalment plan born before this version on a management used in more than one financial year is not recalculated when the program does not know which financial year it belongs to or which items are its own: that is, if it has no financial year saved, or if it is an ordinary plan with no associated items and the management has a plan, draft or approved, in another financial year. «Ricalcola» (recalculate) and the bin icon next to an item stop with a message that says the fact and the way: delete the plan and create it again from the instalment plans page of its financial year, choosing the items. The way is there when recalculating would be possible (no collections and no issues). No figure of the plan moves. The message also names three things that the plan holds and the creation does not take back by itself, when there are any: the manual split of a balance among several holders (with its figures), the items' accrual periods, the moves made with «Sposta spesa» (move expense); they have to be put back in the new plan. For these plans, the messages that ask to recalculate the plan before recording a collection or a refund, before issuing after a sale, or in the check at the start of a lease, also say that recalculating is refused, and the way (when issuing, if the plan is also stopped for another reason, first the steps for that).

CHANGES: THE BIN DOES NOT REMOVE THE LAST ITEM OF A PLAN — On the page of an ordinary instalment plan the bin icon next to an item refuses to remove the last one: a plan with no items, when recalculated, takes all the management's items that no other plan of its financial year already has, and would ask again for the one removed, if no other plan of its financial year has it. The message says to add the other item first with «Sincronizza» (synchronise), if it is free, and then remove this one, or to delete the plan from the instalment plans list if it is no longer needed.

CHANGES: AT EQUAL REMAINDER THE CENT GOES TO WHOEVER HAS BEEN OWNER LONGER — When a division leaves one or more cents to assign and two people have the same remainder, the cent goes to whoever comes first in the split's list: among the holders read from the unit's record, to the one who has been a holder longer and, on the same date, to the one recorded first. Before, the remainders were compared as numbers with a decimal point, where the rounding error could put one of the two ahead, and among the owners of a unit the order in which the database returned the rows decided. With shares of 10/30/60 on 6 cents you get 1, 2 and 3 cents (before 0, 2 and 4); in the test of 2,520 combinations (42 triples of shares, amounts from 1 to 60 cents) 36 gave a different cent. Data already written do not change: issued instalments are in the journal and are not recalculated, and balances, handover settlements, stops and statements already recorded or printed stay as written; a plan not yet issued takes the new rule at the next «Genera» (generate) or «Ricalcola» (recalculate). The sum stays the same as before: one cent moves between two people.

CHANGES: IN «AUDIT & LOGS» ONLY THE «EMAIL LOGS» TAB REMAINS, AND ITS PAGES CAN BE BROWSED — The «Attività Sistema» (system activity) tab of the «Audit & Logs» page (Settings) is gone: the program gave it no data. «Email Logs» remains, the log of the e-mails sent by the program: under the recipient of a test that did not go out the reason appears, in red, with the full text on mouse-over, and the page subtitle says «Il registro delle email inviate dal programma, con il motivo di quelle non partite.» (the log of the e-mails sent by the program, with the reason for those that did not go out). The pages after the first can be reached with the pagination buttons, which before were not links: the rows beyond the first ten could be reached with the search.

CHANGES: THE CASH LIMIT ALSO APPLIES WHEN EDITING A PAYMENT — Editing a payment to a supplier refuses, from € 5,000.00 inclusive, to change a payment made by another method to «Contanti» (cash) and to raise the amount of a payment already in cash, measuring the net amount that goes out. Before, editing checked nothing: a bank transfer of € 6,000.00 could be changed to cash and saved. Correcting the note or the date of a payment already recorded in cash, or changing it to another method, remains possible. The message says «Pagamento in contanti di € 6.000,00 non consentito: è pari o superiore al limite di € 5.000,00 (D.Lgs. 231/2007 antiriciclaggio).» (cash payment of € 6,000.00 not allowed: it is equal to or above the limit of € 5,000.00); before, in registration too, it said «supera il limite di € 5.000» (exceeds the limit of € 5,000), but the ban applies at exactly € 5,000.00 too. The «Pagamento non consentito» (payment not allowed) window, in registration and in editing, shows the program's message with the figure, offers the two methods the page proposes (bank transfer and non-transferable cheque), says «€ 5.000,00» and no longer mentions the card, a range of penalties or «Questo blocco non può essere aggirato» (this block cannot be bypassed). The limit looks at the method chosen, not at the cash box the money comes out of: a payment of € 6,000.00 with the method «Bonifico» (bank transfer) that comes out of a cash box is not stopped.

NEW: THE GENERATION GATE STOPS IF A DECEASED PERSON IS ALSO AN HEIR OF ANOTHER DECEASED PERSON OF THE SAME UNIT — When on a unit a deceased person is also an heir of another deceased person, and both successions pass the arrears to the heirs, the generation gate says so in the item of the one who dies first and, if the plan still calculates something for the heir, in hers too. With Ugo dying first and Ada his heir, in Ada's item: «Ada è anche erede di Ugo su quest'unità (decesso del 1 marzo 2026): la sua parte da erede, € 147,50, il programma non la passa ai suoi eredi, Anna e Bruno.» (Ada is also an heir of Ugo on this unit (death on 1 March 2026): her part as heir, € 147.50, the program does not pass it to her heirs, Anna and Bruno), and in Ugo's «Ada, erede di Ugo, ha a sua volta una successione su quest'unità (decesso del 1 maggio 2026) con l'arretrato passato agli eredi: la sua parte da erede, € 147,50, il programma non la passa ai suoi eredi, Anna e Bruno.» (Ada, heir of Ugo, in turn has a succession on this unit (death on 1 May 2026) with the arrears passed to the heirs: her part as heir, € 147.50, the program does not pass it to her heirs, Anna and Bruno). The items also say «La divisione fra gli eredi la decide l'amministratore: il programma non ne propone le parti né le righe del Wallet, e nessuna riga del Wallet chiude questa voce, che torna a ogni generazione.» (the division among the heirs is decided by the administrator: the program proposes neither the parts nor the Wallet lines, and no Wallet line closes this item, which comes back at every generation). Before, with Ugo and Ada spouses at 50 %, Ugo dead on 1 March with heirs Ada and Anna at 25 % each and Ada dead on 1 May with heirs Anna (45 %) and Bruno (30 %), on an expense of € 3,650.00 the items asked for Wallet lines and then said «Non serve registrare altro» (no need to record anything else), and € 147.50 stayed in the plan in the name of Ada, deceased: Anna paid € 88.50 and Bruno € 59.00 less. The stop moves no money: the plan's sums are those of each person's days, and the part Ada inherited is not passed to her heirs: you decide the division.

FIXES: TWO DECEASED PERSONS ON THE SAME UNIT, ONLY ONE BALANCE LINE FOR THE HEIR, AND THE SAME QUESTIONS ON THE SAME BALANCES — (1) With two co-owners who died the same day with the same heirs, if an heir had a single unlinked balance line equal to each of her two parts (the two parts being equal to the cent) and no linked line, both items said «I saldi ci sono già … Non serve registrare altro» (the balances are already there … no need to record anything else), and the plan absorbed the line once: Anna paid € 601.65 instead of € 720.01. Now the second deceased person's item says that balance is already the part for the first one and asks for the linked balance: «Il saldo non legato di Anna (€ 118,36 a debito) è già la sua parte per Ugo: per quella di Ada serve il saldo legato.» (Anna's unlinked balance (€ 118.36 owed) is already her part for Ugo: for Ada's part the linked balance is needed). Following the items, everyone pays their parts once. (2) With two deceased persons on the same unit and an heir without linked lines, the items asked the same question («il programma non sa se comprendono la parte», the program does not know whether they include the part) on the same balances. With different shares in the two successions, answering «la comprendono» (they include it) in the wrong item, Anna paid € 625.32 instead of € 720.01; with a balance that included the part of one succession and a carry-over, answering «la comprendono» in both items she paid € 651.65 instead of € 770.01. Now, if the unlinked balances are the part for one deceased person, for the other the item asks for the linked balance and says so; if they are not for either, the items after the first say they are the same balances: «Il saldo non legato di Anna è lo stesso anche per Ugo: comprende la sua parte per Ugo e per Ada solo se comprende le due parti insieme, € 236,72 a debito; se ne comprende una sola, per l'altra serve il saldo legato.» (Anna's unlinked balance is the same for Ugo too: it includes her part for Ugo and for Ada only if it includes both parts together, € 236.72 owed; if it includes only one, the linked balance is needed for the other) (in the plural if the lines are more than one). The sentence is there with three or more deceased persons as well. Plans already issued with a part missing are not flagged by any page and the fix does not repair them; a plan that can still be recalculated has the gate at the next «Ricalcola».

FIXES: THE HEADING SENTENCE OF THE ANCILLARY CHARGES STATEMENT WITH SEVERAL TENANTS TOGETHER, AND THE PREVIEW WITH A NET INCOME — (1) The print of the ancillary charges statement said it divides by days of tenancy with the same rule as the allocation even for a unit with two tenants at the same time, where it was not true (with Dora in on 1/4 and no one out, Ines € 360.00 in the statement against € 205.31 in the plan). Now the heading says the rule by share and by days, and for whoever came in after a plan was generated it adds a sentence: «Dal 01/07/2026 Luca è inquilino insieme a Ines, ma il piano «Preventivo 2026» è stato generato prima: le cifre sono quelle del piano com'era, con la parte dell'inquilino di quei giorni nelle rate di Ines, e Luca, per quei giorni, non ha voci. Un piano generato dopo dividerà quelle voci fra Ines e Luca, per quota e per giorni.» (from 01/07/2026 Luca is a tenant together with Ines, but the plan «Preventivo 2026» was generated before: the figures are those of the plan as it was, with the tenant's part for those days in Ines's instalments, and Luca, for those days, has no items. A plan generated afterwards will divide those items between Ines and Luca, by share and by days). The statement's figures do not change. (2) The usufruct handover preview quoted only art. 1004 of the Civil Code even when the net is income: now, in the setting up and in the ending, it says that expenses follow art. 1004 and income, if it is civil fruits, art. 984; with a net expense the sentence is as before. The sentence chooses by the sign of each management's adjustment: if on one management it is a credit for the incoming person it also quotes art. 984, otherwise only art. 1004, even when a net expense includes an income.

NEW: THE E-MAIL SENDING TEST SAYS WHY IT FAILS — (1) The reason for a failed sending test can be read in the e-mail log («Audit & Logs di Sistema», «Email Logs»), under the recipient, and the program also writes it in its error log («Prova di invio email fallita: …», test of sending e-mail failed, with driver, host, port and encryption, without the password). (2) If the connection is refused and the port is not 587, under the reason there is a suggestion: «La connessione alla porta … è stata rifiutata: o il server di posta non la accetta su quella porta, o le connessioni in uscita su quella porta sono bloccate dal tuo server o dal suo provider (alcuni provider lo fanno per la 25 e la 465). Prova la 587 con la crittografia TLS.» (the connection to port … was refused: either the mail server does not accept it on that port, or outgoing connections on that port are blocked by your server or its provider (some providers do so for 25 and 465). Try 587 with TLS encryption). It appears only for this form of refusal: a server that is reached and answers with an error, or a timeout, does not have it. (3) The test warning says «Hai modifiche non salvate. La prova usa i valori che vedi nel modulo ma non li salva: per tenerli, salva la configurazione.» (you have unsaved changes. The test uses the values you see in the form but does not save them: to keep them, save the configuration); before, it said to save before sending, but the test already used the values in the form. (4) The mail guide no longer says that the «Mittente (Address)» (sender) must be identical to the account: it depends on the provider. With a mailbox (Aruba, Gmail) it is the mailbox address; with a sending service (SMTP2GO, Brevo, Mailgun) it must be an address, or a domain, verified in the service's panel.

FIXES: TEXTS THAT PROMISED MORE THAN THE PROGRAM DOES — (1) The supplier's tab said that the withholding feeds the «F24 e CU» automations (the Certificazione Unica, the annual withholding certificate, does not exist): now the box is called «Ritenuta e delega F24» (withholding tax and F24 form) and says the program separates out the net amount to pay and feeds the withholding schedule, from which it prepares the F24 form; the «Dati fiscali» (tax data) guide of the Structure says the tax code is the taxpayer's code in the F24 forms. (2) The «Gestione saldi pregressi» (management of previous balances) box on the instalment plans page now has «Vai ai saldi iniziali» (go to the opening balances), when there is an open financial year (without one, the balances page sends you back with an error, and the box stays without the link). (3) The «Stato Incassi» (collection status) box of the instalment plan said the instalments are collected from the Prima nota (journal) or by importing bank movements: the Prima nota is a read-only register and the import does not exist. Now it says «Le rate emesse si incassano da «Incassi rate», nei movimenti.» (issued instalments are collected from «Incassi rate», in the movements) and has «Vai agli incassi rate» (go to the instalment collections). (4) The refusal to delete a management with previous balances no longer sends you to the «Saldi» (balances) section, which shows only the open financial year: it says how many balances of owners and how many debts to suppliers it contains and where they can be seen. (5) The invoices guide says that with collections reversing remains possible, except for the invoice with lines on specific units (an expense charged to individuals, «ad personam») that an issued instalment has already asked for: the reason for the refusal says the way, which goes through the plan.

FIXES: «MODIFICA GESTIONE» AND THE DELETION OF A FINANCIAL YEAR — (1) «Modifica gestione» (edit management) on a management used in more than one financial year wrote the dates of the new year's period reversed («dal 01/01/2027 al 31/12/2026», from 01/01/2027 to 31/12/2026); now it writes the part of the management that falls in the financial year, and if it has no days in common with the financial year it leaves the dates empty, like the importer. The lines already reversed stay; the program does not read those dates. (2) If the deletion of a financial year is requested by hand (no page offers it since 1.10.0-beta.17), the program refuses it when the financial year has owners' balances, debts to suppliers, residual credits, instalment plans, managements linked only to it, an amount already paid of its own, invoices or F24 forms, and the message says how many; it also counts the journal entries deleted with the previous method. A closed financial year, other than the last one, with none of this is still deleted. Before, deleting a closed financial year with no journal entries silently took away its balances and residual credits, and removed the financial year from its plans. The guard counts the plans that have the financial year saved: a plan without it, which the program reads in that financial year by its creation date, does not hold it back.

CHANGES: THE PANEL UPDATE ENGINE — The engine, once the launch token has been accepted, no longer stops if the page that started it is closed (tab closed, timeout of the web server or proxy): before, PHP noticed the closed page at the first progress line written and interrupted the update halfway, with the file copy incomplete and no rollback. A page opened without the launch, or a refused launch, does not change. The engine no longer writes to the .env the lines DB_CHARSET, DB_COLLATION and DB_ENGINE under the TRUSTED_PROXIES block: those lines brought the database connection to utf8, which does not save emojis. Tables already created are not converted. As the first entry says, these rules apply to updates that start from this version.

CHANGES: THE DOCKER AND SYNOLOGY GUIDES — (1) The guide for developing with Docker (Italian, English, Spanish and Portuguese) clones the repository's default branch and, for a precise version, a tag; it says at the top that it is for developing KondoManager and not for using it; it publishes the development stack's ports (application, MySQL, Supervisor) only on 127.0.0.1, so they answer only from the computer Docker runs on; it describes what the start-up scripts really do. (2) The Synology guide is rewritten on the production image ghcr.io/vince844/kondomanager-core (version 1.11.0): two files, a docker-compose.yml and a .env, created in Container Manager; no database port, no test password written in the guide, no shared folder linked to the container, no chmod; key and passwords are created with openssl; the section «Per togliere la prova» (to remove the test) says how to remove everything. The guide says at the top, in four languages, that it has not yet been tried on a NAS: the image has been tried elsewhere, the Container Manager steps have not. (3) The production Docker image builds the frontend with Node 22 instead of Node 20.

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE — (1) The amount already paid recorded before this version applies to «Tutti gli esercizi»: where the management is used in more than one financial year the next year's plan on that item stops when, together with the earlier year's plan, what the plans ask on the item exceeds its amount, and keeps stopping until you indicate the financial year; plans already generated do not change figures. (2) Plans that an earlier version had already moved to the wrong financial year, by recalculating them from the list of another financial year, have that financial year today, and which amount already paid they take off depends on the plan's financial year (in the example, Ugo € 700.00 instead of € 400.00). (3) The list of instalment plans of a financial year also shows the plans of the other financial year of a management used in two years, without saying which financial year they are in, and opens them inside the page's financial year. (4) An item's amount is one for all financial years: an item raised for one year's invoices changes the share with which another year's plan takes off its amount already paid. (5) The plan page, the dashboard and the chart of accounts count the plans of all financial years to say whether an item is covered: a 2027 item can appear covered by the 2026 plan. (6) The fixed order of the owners applies to the owners read from the unit's page; the allocation of joint balances and the ancillary charges statement read the owners by themselves, and on the same date the order stays the one in which the database returns them. (7) With two deceased persons on the same unit and different shares in the two successions, one item may say that the program does not know whether a balance includes the part and the other that that balance is already the part for the other deceased person: the sums add up in every reading, and one more generation is needed. The same goes for the part that enters twice in one item while the other says «non sa» (does not know): following the items, the figures per person add up. (8) The program does not divide among her heirs the part that a deceased person inherited from another deceased person: the administrator decides the division. (9) The cash limit looks at the payment method and not at the cash box; payments already saved in cash above the limit stay as they were and no page flags them. (10) The Synology guide has not been tried on a NAS, and the Docker development guide has not been started on a clean computer: it is not proved that the ports on 127.0.0.1 answer from a Windows browser with WSL2. (11) The English and Portuguese translations of the new texts have not been reviewed by a native speaker.
